snippet.title: Paper Detour - Grain Test 03 | Amplitude x3, Larger Grain | 15s | 4K | Private Review
snippet.description: Private technical preview, not a release. Same 15-second Paper Detour 030 parallax excerpt (source frames 811-1260, V07-V09). Test03 changes only the grain preset: peak luma RMS 3.6 eight-bit codes (x3 relative to Test01, 25 percent below Test02) and Gaussian sigma 1.15 UHD pixels (15 percent larger kernel than Test02). Luma-only, temporal correlation 0.65, protected shadows and highlights. Existing camera, parallax, timing and accepted audio retained. 3840x2160, 30 fps. Compare 2160p and 1080p. Awaiting user review; production defaults remain unchanged.
